touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Metheringham qualifies as a local detour through Village cross and Church of St Wilfrid. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Metheringham: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Metheringham offers Village cross, Church of St Wilfrid, MARKET CROSS within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Village cross
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Village cross and Church of St Wilfrid, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
